I replied to Ilse in their DM to confirm the new cutoff: the Quarrendon Freight Lines paperwork is now due 7 July, and I'll keep it private.

I didn't save the note in the shared knowledge base or in my own memory files. Both could bring it up in other members' conversations, which would break "keep it between us." The note is only in that DM. They asked for no action, so I took none beyond the reply.
